errata.orig: Usage of Intra-AS I-PMSI A-D routes is described in Section 9.2.
errata.correct: Usage of Intra-AS I-PMSI A-D routes is described in Section 9.1.
errata.notes: Section 9.2 defines Inter-AS I-PMSI A-D operation and is not the right reference to be called in Section 4.1

errata.orig: Usage of Inter-AS I-PMSI A-D routes is described in Section 9.1
errata.correct: Usage of Inter-AS I-PMSI A-D routes is described in Section 9.2
errata.notes: Section 9.1 defines Intra-AS I-PMSI A-D operation and is not the right reference to be called in Section 4.2

errata.orig:
The Source AS field in the C-multicast
route is set to value of the Originating Router's IP Address field of
the found Intra-AS I-PMSI A-D route.
errata.correct:
The Source AS field in the C-multicast
route is set to value of the Originating Router's IP Address field of
the found Intra-AS I-PMSI A-D route when the Originating Router's IP
Address is an IPv4 address.
errata.notes: Source AS field in C-multicast route is a 4-octet field, and only an IPv4 address is possible to be filled in it. The Originating Router's IP Address can be an IPv6 address according to RFC6515.
